observations.body: The prayer recalls Egypt, sea, cloud and fire, then says God came down at Sinai, spoke from heaven, gave laws and Sabbath, and provided bread and water.
observations.label: Public prayer remembers speech from heaven at Sinai

observations.body: Public prayer remembers speech from heaven at Sinai belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Nehemiah 9:9–15 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Nehemiah 9:9–15 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Public prayer remembers speech from heaven at Sinai belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: Public prayer remembers speech from heaven at Sinai
